meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按代码结构(AST 形状)而不是文本去搜索和改写代码,支持 25 种语言:找出所有形状相同的调用、类、导入等。改写默认先出预览,加 --apply 才真正改动文件。
howto.when: 当目标是代码结构(某个形状的调用、类、导入等),或要做 codemod、跑 YAML 规则时由它接管;若目标只是字符串、注释或文件名,则改用 rg。

say.text: 帮我找出所有以 Request 作为参数的函数。
say.note: helper search 会先列出所有匹配

say.text: 跑一下项目里的 YAML 规则,报告违规项。
say.note: helper scan 按规则扫描并输出结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can search and rewrite code by AST shape rather than text across 25 languages—finding every call, class, or import shaped like X. Rewrites preview first and only change files when --apply is set.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is code structure (a call/class/import shaped like X), a codemod, or a YAML rule; for plain strings, comments, or filenames use rg instead.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter.
say_en.note: helper search lists the matches first

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x) in this repo.
say_en.note: dry-run by default; add --apply to write

say_en.text: Run the project's YAML rules and report violations.
